cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Hope Keeps Moving
cards.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll find our wedding venue. The hall said no; we're meant to have somewhere less municipal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every venue is booked for June.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you choose a September weekend. Three more months to practise being married.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My parents can't travel in September.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll go to them. Ask about their garden; I'll do the arranging. We're finding where this wedding belongs.

reason: Replace status announcement with concrete shared planning and an explicit request to ask about the parents garden; each disappointment redirects the same desired wedding.
